title: Algophony Listening Modes
description: Listening modes for Algophony evaluation, mapped from the AKOÚŌ framework.

modes.label: Signal Inspection Listening
modes.description: Technical analysis of signal properties: duration, frequency, dynamics, noise floor, artifacts.
modes.algophony_use: Measure loopability, detect model artifacts, assess spectral characteristics.

modes.label: Acoulogical Object Listening
modes.description: Identifying and describing perceptual sound objects within the soundscape.
modes.algophony_use: Identify sources, assess source accuracy, detect false or hallucinated sources.

modes.label: Embodied Affective Listening
modes.description: Somatic and emotional response to the sonic environment.
modes.algophony_use: Assess mood/style adherence, detect generic emotional coding.

modes.label: Transductive Media Listening
modes.description: Attending to the technical mediation shaping what is heard.
modes.algophony_use: Detect false field recording aesthetics, assess documentary ambiguity.

modes.label: Forensic Archival Listening
modes.description: Treating sound as evidence, artifact, or historical document.
modes.algophony_use: Evaluate archive prompts, assess media decay simulation, temporal distance.

modes.label: Ecological Posthuman Listening
modes.description: Attending to habitat relations, nonhuman agency, and ecological structure.
modes.algophony_use: Assess ecological plausibility, biophonic logic, generic naturalism.

modes.label: Critical Political Listening
modes.description: Attending to power, erasure, representation, and political context in sound.
modes.algophony_use: Assess cultural cliché, stereotyping, representational violence.

modes.label: Musical Aesthetic Listening
modes.description: Attending to rhythm, pitch, timbre, texture, and aesthetic quality.
modes.algophony_use: Assess club exterior prompts, ritual musicality, sound-design quality.

modes.label: Symbolic Fictional Listening
modes.description: Reading sound as myth, fiction, symbol, or possible-world construction.
modes.algophony_use: Assess impossible ecology prompts, speculative soundscape coherence.

algophony_composite_modes.label: Situated Urban Listening
algophony_composite_modes.description: Composite mode combining acoulogical, ecological, and critical-political listening for urban soundscapes.

algophony_composite_modes.label: False Ecology Audit
algophony_composite_modes.description: Composite mode for detecting generic naturalism and ecological implausibility.
